subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat poll session: direct text reply not delivered to QQ user

question: Should heartbeat delivery for QQ direct sessions ever inherit `lastTo` across a selected-channel mismatch, or should fixes preserve same-channel/turn-source routing and require explicit targets or docs?
rationale: The remaining behavior is not a mechanical code cleanup: relaxing the guard may fix the reported delivery loss but can also misroute heartbeat content across channels.

options.title: Preserve the guard and localize QQ routing
options.body: Keep generic mismatch inheritance behind the existing guard, then require a narrow QQ/source-level fix plus redacted live C2C heartbeat proof.

options.title: Approve heartbeat-wide mismatch inheritance
options.body: Allow heartbeat mode to inherit `lastTo` across mismatches only with explicit maintainer acceptance of the delivery/security tradeoff and regression proof.

options.title: Document explicit message-tool delivery
options.body: Treat automatic direct heartbeat replies as unsupported for this QQ path and update docs to require explicit `channel` and `target` sends.

recommendation.title: Preserve the guard and localize QQ routing
recommendation.body: Keep generic mismatch inheritance behind the existing guard, then require a narrow QQ/source-level fix plus redacted live C2C heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct work on heartbeat direct delivery and fail-closed shared-session routing, which are the core policy tradeoffs here.
